type Flag<T> = T extends `${infer B extends boolean}` ? B : never;
const trueOnly: Flag<'true'> = false;
const falseOnly: Flag<'false'> = true;
type Numeric<T> = T extends `${infer N extends 1 | 3}` ? N : never;
const numeric: Numeric<'1'> = 3;
type Big<T> = T extends `${infer V extends 2n | 4n}` ? V : never;
const bigint: Big<'2'> = 4n;
type Mixed<T> = T extends `${infer B extends boolean | 'true'}` ? B : never;
const stringFirst: Mixed<'true'> = true;
